WITH matched AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    CASE WHEN s.boxy IS NOT NULL AND s.boxx IS NOT NULL AND s.boxx <> 0
         THEN (s.boxy - s.boxx) / s.boxx END AS y_vs_x,
    CASE WHEN s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 <> 0
         THEN s.aream2 / s.volm3 END AS area_volume
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
), per_source AS (
  SELECT fundflux,
         AVG(y_vs_x) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference,
         AVG(area_volume) AS area_volume_figure
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY fundflux
), with_cross_source_avg AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(area_volume_figure) OVER () AS cross_source_average
  FROM per_source
)
SELECT fundflux,
       avg_y_vs_x_difference,
       area_volume_figure,
       area_volume_figure - cross_source_average AS above_cross_source_average
FROM with_cross_source_avg
WHERE area_volume_figure > cross_source_average;

assumptions.assumption: The cross-source average is the unweighted arithmetic mean of each funding source's per-source area-to-volume figure; NULL figures are excluded by SQLite AVG.
